purpose: Preserve the current product idea, architecture and implementation state of the JANUS HELIOS ecosystem.
Allow work to resume after context loss without rebuilding the concept from chat history.
Separate implemented and manually observed behavior from simulation, open gates and production claims.
short_product_definition: JANUS HELIOS is a web-first buyer-configurable slot-shaped compute-routing asset. The game surface, compute router, provider adapters, receipt verification, value/impact sinks and procedural presentation layers are intentionally separated so approved compute can be redirected toward different workloads without rewriting game mathematics.

conceptual_origin.routing_metaphor: One station, one source of available compute, many replaceable destinations. The buyer decides where approved compute is routed.
conceptual_origin.helios_one_note: The HELIOS naming and station-routing metaphor is conceptual inspiration only. No Fallout artwork, interface, text, source code or proprietary asset is intended to be copied.
conceptual_origin.nerdminer_v2_note: BitMaker-hub/NerdMiner_v2 was examined as architectural inspiration for separation of concurrent responsibilities. NerdMiner is an ESP32 solo miner, not a beat-maker. No NerdMiner source code is copied into HELIOS; the useful abstraction is independent monitor/work/worker loops. The reference repository is MIT licensed.

SSlot.design_intent: Verified shared mining/economic compute may fund a separate Compute Treasury and aggregate jackpot reserve. Personal compute must not increase personal jackpot weight.

DIVINE_REALM.design_intent: Scientific/public-good specialization. Real impact claims require a compatible scientific Requestor and authoritative upstream acceptance.

ecosystem.inheritance_rule: Children inherit shared consent, resource, security and receipt contracts from HELIOS by contract, but do not inherit HELIOS public route-switching product behavior.
ecosystem.promotion_rule: If a child-specific mechanism proves generally useful, generalize the primitive and promote it into HELIOS without erasing the child's fixed product identity.

reference_routes.example: Golem or another approved compute market
future admissible provider/workload unknown at design time

modes.HELIOS: Balanced 3-line universal profile with cascades, Solar Corona and D Lydian procedural audio.
modes.DIVINE: Radiant 5-line profile with cascades and A Lydian procedural audio.
modes.GRIDJACK: Treasury 9-line profile with cascades, route-wide demo Spin Energy and E Dorian procedural audio.
modes.CUSTOM: Buyer-configurable 3-path profile with cascades and C# Void Minor procedural audio.

sequence: repeat while paid win and within max cascades

demo_spin_energy.important_distinction: This demonstrates compute-earned non-cash demo entitlements. It must not silently become a production retention loop that converts compute into real-money wagers or free spins.

examples.CASCADE_X1_X4_X16_X64: progressively higher register and denser arrangement
examples.COMPUTE_ACTIVE: low engine pulse or drone joins continuous music

procedural_cosmic_music.manual_observation: User explicitly confirmed that the v2 generative music is audible and working in the live demo after the sequencer rewrite.

economics_and_value_model.general_rule: Verified compute value or impact is accounted separately from game outcomes.

marketplace_example.provider: Golem or another approved compute market
marketplace_example.demo_split_history: 70% player / 30% treasury was used only as an illustrative accounting example and is not a promised commercial rate.

economics_and_value_model.sslot_example: Verified mining/economic compute may flow into a shared Compute Treasury and aggregate jackpot reserve, never into personal jackpot weighting based on personal compute.
economics_and_value_model.divine_example: Accepted scientific work may enter an Impact Ledger, but compute hours or provider payment are not scientific or medical outcomes.

licensing_and_ip.ip_boundary: Copyright protects the authored implementation and materials; broader exclusivity over abstract methods may require contractual and/or patent strategy.

key_helios_files.helios.js: Game core, reel animation, cascades, multiplier ladder, routing UI and Spin Energy
key_helios_files.helios-polish.js: Observer/render-only polish layer, ticker, custom bet picker, win trace, UI SFX and mode matrix

P0_INTEGRITY_AND_TEST: Execute the full Janus-HELIOS test suite and record the actual result; do not infer CI green from syntax checks.
Add or enable a reproducible CI workflow if repository policy permits it.
Add explicit browser-level tests for cascades, Solar Corona, Spin Energy countdown/bank, mode changes and music enable/disable.
P1_REAL_COMPUTE: Implement a real server-side provider gateway starting with a non-money or testnet path.
Preferred first concrete gate: Golem testnet -> Yagna -> real Agreement/Activity/Invoice/Payment -> authoritative receipt -> HELIOS verifier.
Implement signed provider manifests, receipt signatures and anti-replay protections.
Keep all provider, wallet and Yagna secrets server-side.
P2_SPECIALIZED_CHILDREN: SSlot: connect one approved economic/mining upstream and verify treasury accounting without personal jackpot weighting.
DIVINE_REALM: connect one real compatible scientific Requestor and require authoritative upstream acceptance before impact ledger entries.
P3_BUYER_ASSET: Build a HELIOS Operator/Buyer Configurator so a buyer can change branding, modes, route manifests, workload class, sink and safe public policy without editing source code.
Add import/export of signed buyer configuration manifests.
Add provider compatibility and admission diagnostics for CPU/GPU/runtime/data sensitivity/verification/economics.
P4_TELEMETRY_AND_SAFETY: Add energy, thermal, battery and idle-priority telemetry.
Add hard CPU/GPU/time/data-transfer budgets enforced outside the game loop.
Perform independent security, privacy, legal and responsible-gaming review before any production or real-money deployment.
P5_PRESENTATION: Preserve the current retro-cosmic generative music identity and tune carefully rather than replacing it.
Possible future audio polish: rare radio beacon, subtle analog drift and a distinct x64/SOLAR FLARE transition while preserving forbidden-adaptation boundaries.
Continue responsive UI polish without making Telegram a HELIOS dependency.
P6_COMMERCIAL_PILOT: Run a non-money pilot with a real provider and authoritative receipts.
Use pilot evidence to produce a partner integration package and pricing/licensing model.
Do not claim production readiness, guaranteed profitability, guaranteed jackpot funding, scientific outcomes or provider settlement until independently verified.

recovery_instructions: Read this checkpoint first after context loss.
Then inspect Janus-HELIOS .janus/HELIOS_ARCHITECTURE.json and PROJECT_STATUS.json at or after the recorded main HEAD.
Treat Janus-HELIOS as the universal parent; do not reintroduce public route switching into SSlot or DIVINE_REALM unless the product architecture is intentionally changed.
Preserve all immutable fairness and security boundaries when adding providers, game modes or audio behavior.
When newer committed code conflicts with this checkpoint, prefer newer source-of-truth files but document the divergence in a new checkpoint rather than silently rewriting history.
